title: Post-sync: follow-ups and exec asks for QBR prep
text:
Post-sync: follow-ups and exec asks for QBR prep

["From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Bethany Cruz <bethany.cruz@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-sync: follow-ups and exec asks for QBR prep

Thanks all for a focused sync this morning. Quick recap and who-owns-what so we can lock the QBR narrative by EOD Friday. Attaching the latest deck draft.

Key outcomes (short):
- Acme execs want a 5–7 min summary of latency/cost improvements and a one-slide plan for security/compliance gaps. (Bethany asked specifically for SOC2 evidence and a short note about private deployment options.)
- We agreed to surface per-route token economics in the deck, with a short appendix for dedicated vs hosted cost profiles.
- Action items below are prioritized for the QBR readiness review on Thursday.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Finalize QBR deck narrative and SLIDE #3 (latency/cost summary) — Grace O'Connor — Thu 2027-02-11 12:00 PT.
2) Compile SOC2 artifact list + retention note — Aditya Rao — Wed 2027-02-10 18:00 PT.
3) Add per-route token economics appendix + sample billing breakdown — Jonas Weber — Thu 2027-02-11 16:00 PT.
4) Draft one-slide private deployment options + risks for execs — Lauren Bishop — Thu 2027-02-11 12:00 PT.
5) Coordinate with Acme on desired level of detail for the security appendix — Grace (owner) / Bethany (ACME contact) — Wed 2027-02-10 EOD.

Attachments: QBR-Prep-Deck-v2.pdf (attached), security-acro-questions.xlsx (attached).

Notes: keep items succinct — this is an exec-level presentation. If anyone expects a blocker hitting their task, flag it in-reply and we will reassign.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
", "From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Bethany Cruz <bethany.cruz@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-sync: follow-ups and exec asks for QBR prep

Thanks Grace — quick status: I'm on the SOC2 artifact list. Preliminary answers below and I'll drop the spreadsheet with pointers by 6pm PT:
- Data flow diagram and retention policy excerpt: available (will attach).
- Audit log retention: we keep logs for 365 days by default, can support 730 with Enterprise plan note.
- Encryption at rest: KMS/HSM options documented; will include required references.

One exec ask to call out in the deck: potential SLA exception for a specific customer workload we flagged last quarter (high message burst). Recommend one line in risks slide that we have a mitigation plan (burst queue + fallback model variant) and an ask for a small credit/penalty carve-out in contract negotiations.

I'll attach security-acro-questions.xlsx in the thread and a short exec-asks log for the QBR.

-Aditya

On Tue, Feb 10, 2027 at 9:12 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message clipped]", "From: Bethany Cruz <bethany.cruz@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-sync: follow-ups and exec asks for QBR prep

Thanks Grace and team — appreciated the quick sync. A few clarifications from Acme's side: 
1) For the SOC2 artifacts we only need a pointer to the control owner and sample evidence (not full reports) — a short appendix will be fine.
2) For the SLA exception, our execs expect to see a concrete mitigation timeline (30/60/90 day steps) and whether Redwood will commit to incident postmortems for any uptime deviations over the next quarter.

Can you confirm if the 365->730 retention note will be in writing for our procurement team? Also, please keep the private deployment slide light — our execs want tradeoffs and recommended next steps, not implementation detail.

Happy to review a pre-read Thursday morning.

—Bethany
VP Product, Acme Analytics
", "From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Bethany Cruz <bethany.cruz@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-sync: follow-ups and exec asks for QBR prep — consolidated action register

On Fri, Feb 12, 2027 at 10:30 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> [previous thread]

Team — consolidating status after ad-hoc updates. Updated action register below (I moved a couple of due dates to reflect Acme's review window). If there are no objections, I will publish this as the working plan and circulate the pre-read link to Bethany and her team by Friday 5pm PT.

Consolidated action register: 
- Grace O'Connor — Finalize slide deck narrative, slide 3 latency/cost summary — new due: Thu 2027-02-11 15:00 PT — STATUS: Done (deck v2 attached).
- Aditya Rao — SOC2 artifacts list + retention note for procurement — due: Wed 2027-02-10 18:00 PT — STATUS: Delivered (see security-acro-questions.xlsx).
- Jonas Weber — per-route economics appendix + sample billing breakdown — due: Thu 2027-02-11 16:00 PT — STATUS: In progress (draft uploaded to Drive).
- Lauren Bishop — private deployment options one-pager + risks — due: Thu 2027-02-11 12:00 PT — STATUS: Done (one-pager attached).

Next steps: Grace to send pre-read link by Fri 17:00 PT; Aditya to confirm retention note language in writing for procurement; Jonas to finish appendix and be on the 13:00 PT review call on Thursday.

Attachments: QBR-Prep-Deck-v2.pdf, security-acro-questions.xlsx (referenced), Private-Deployment-OnePager.pdf (attached).

Thanks — Lauren
Senior Product Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
"]
